newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila mining stocks sub-index down 7.39 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila mining stocks sub-index down 7.39 pct.

text.p: Manila's mining stocks sub-index fell by 468.18 points, or 7.39 percent, to 5,867.31 points in late trade on Monday as the sector was seen affected by doubts raised over the Busang gold find in Indonesia, brokers said.

"There were concerns that the Busang find may not be as large as projected. It probably dawned on investors here that in mining, what is expected to be there, may not be there at all. The Busang incident is like a reality check on investors," Helen Alvarez, research head at All Asia Securities said.
